doctrine:
Scope: this worktree owns reduction of code, tests, gate work and API/binary surface through source-bound AST and control/data-flow analysis. Its plan contains only its own work. Master, GUI and audio campaigns remain in their originating worktrees. Removing their inherited rows here neither completes nor cancels them; Git and OvergoDB retain their history. Do not import another worktree's plan. The operator explicitly directed this correction after 9565ed5c.

Priority: analyze the complete gate cycle before choosing the next optimization. Rank avoidable execution, repeated analysis and recovery cost from retained attempts; distinguish actual execution from planned work, independent invalidators from overlapping reasons, and commit latency from completion of deferred obligations. Prove the cheapest sufficient simplification through existing AST, dependency and execution owners. Consolidate preparation, checks, admission and evidence reuse; delete displaced paths. Preflight and publication consume one recipe. Preserve independent oracles, exact input binding and durable recovery. Keep analysis and its selected bounded implementation in one integration boundary; do not pay a full gate merely to publish another analysis row. Reassess the remaining bottleneck after each measured change. Existing test-input, fixture and API work remains local; reconcile landed changes before repeating it.

Execution: codex-surface-lead owns this lane. Claim each integration boundary with role surface-area-reduction; keep commands and consoles in this worktree. Review existing committed implementations before writing alternatives. Port only reviewed relevant code, preserving caller migrations and local fixes; do not merge unrelated runtime, scheduling or acceptance policy. Dependencies name local producer steps, not source commits or foreign tasks. Continue by updating this plan when measured outcomes expose the next useful reduction; an empty dispatch is not completion of the broader objective.

Proof: use existing repoanalysis, codeprofile and codemanifest owners. Record changed source, build context, call/read/effect paths, independent invalidators and retained evidence. Sequence diagrams project those same facts; no separate graph authority. Missing or unresolved edges retain required coverage. Preserve independent numerical, cancellation, recovery and format oracles, fixture lifetimes and error paths. Compare complete caller migrations and net SLOC/AST, duplicate excess, exports, imports and link targets. A harness increase requires a measured total-cost benefit; renamed wrappers do not count as consolidation.

Acceptance: capability freeze enforced by structure. Each row retains its existing lower-bound checks; before closing an implementation step, use plan -setverify to bind its concrete reduction and counterexample acceptance in the owning package. No zero-match, missing-fixture or skipped-case credit. UNAVAILABLE inputs are explicit obligations to find or construct with provenance. Cheap static checks precede expensive verification; exact prior evidence is reused only when every relevant input matches. Preserve required gates and commit through their existing owner. Do not weaken acceptance or use throughput alone to declare correctness failure. Publish measured results and outstanding obligations, then return to dispatch.

items.title: Simplify gate control to increase commit pace

steps.title: Prove cheaper retries and faster verified commits
steps.rationale: Use one source-bound result owner for per-package and lane reuse; preserve successful independent work after another check fails. Invalidate on actual code/read/effect, toolchain, protocol, evaluator, fixture, environment and required policy changes; unknown reach remains covered. Exercise unchanged input, documentation-only edit, gate-only edit, affected runtime change, renamed test, tampered evidence, interrupted publication and concurrent shared/exclusive users. Deferred batch checks remain durable cumulative obligations; checkpoints never masquerade as completion. Prove at least one expensive real exclusion or exact reuse and a seeded regression still detected. Compare complete commit and retry cycles against retained baselines, separating execution, contention and operator interventions; no repeated runs to seek a favorable time. Record actual executed/reused/failed/unstarted work, net surface change and remaining dominant costs. Lower-bound tests alone do not close the row: bind the specific reduction and recovery assertions, then use one required integration gate and its retained outcome. Retained merge reference: b6e39250 took 29m18.293s with 114 packages reused and 122 executed; result evidence:sha256:b788274c08aad9896477391ac0745379dac20af74cd5c746c6f1312a619de9e9 and cost evidence:sha256:bee9c4239c80c98ae8f5b2f23030c9d759cbe146ec7882ef86ece34d8015a815. Compare matched change classes, not unrelated merge and ordinary commit durations. Include ee9830aa's deferred lane outcome in total verification cost; faster publication alone does not establish less processing. Prioritize the remaining causal-cost investigation from single-sequence: explain expensive dependent execution and zero reuse, evaluate removed-input selection against base/candidate readers, and compare repeated acceptance/setup with existing receipt reuse. Select one lowest-total-cost sufficient reduction; do not implement all alternatives. Deferred correctness is a prerequisite, not a claimed speedup. New concrete hypothesis from source review: executeDeferredLanes loads a local retry cache for executeChecks while stepTestPlan/packageCachePartition can independently load g.retryCache; both save the same retry file. Reproduce whether completed package evidence is overwritten, compare phase/package synchronization, then consolidate one cache owner and durable write path if confirmed. Test phase/package interleavings, interruption, restart, negative invalidation and independent successes after failure; avoid merely sharing an unsynchronized map. Audit the previous two skipped audioparity cases as explicit OVERGO_STORE_ACCEPTANCE exclusions, not missing files: their reference paths were supplied, but the opt-in store-lineage condition was unset. Resolve applicable retained-store authority in surface-test-inputs; do not enable unrelated model runs to make a generic package receipt look complete.

items.title: Remove broad source and process reach from common test fixtures

steps.title: Remove broad source and process reach from common test fixtures
steps.rationale: Merged-state reconciliation: b6e39250 already includes master's testvocab/testprocess split. Inspect the resulting consumer graph and retained skips before dispatch; implement only residual broad reach and duplicate ownership, not another copy of the landed split. First implementation: inventory all consumers of testutil's Go vocabulary scanner and modeltest process helpers. Review master's a96def5e and98cef84f code before choosing the smallest compatible port or consolidation. Preserve every vocabulary scope, literal/variable case, process protocol and numerical assertion. Prefer existing static-analysis owners or actual build contexts to another parallel helper package; if a shared owner is required, migrate all callers and delete displaced wrappers. Compare default Windows/Linux and windows modeltest closures. Freeze an unaffected expensive consumer and a genuinely affected counterexample before changing anything. Bind acceptance proving at least one real exclusion plus retained scanner/process coverage, and measure net source/import changes. Do not import master plan rows or unrelated gate policy. The current code also stages testskip.StoreAcceptance and StoreAcceptanceEnv against a removed foreign row. Their local retirement obligation is now this step: inspect their three-package callers and retained-store identity requirements, consume applicable existing fixes or replace duplicated skip controls with the existing fixture authority, and retain or retire each symbol with exact evidence. Do not suppress a missing fixture or mark foreign work complete; resolve affected fixture inputs before acceptance.

steps.title: Consolidate expensive candidate-repository setup
steps.rationale: Merged-state reconciliation: b6e39250 adopted shared gate discovery, removed the duplicate live graph helper, and cleared cloned candidate byte caches. Retain those changes; remaining work is safe partial-seed restoration and measured residual setup consolidation. Review12a021ad and a344bb47 against the local live graph helper and retained17-minute package cost. Share immutable discovery and compatible repository setup through one existing test owner. Do not duplicate livePackageGraph or packageInputGraph.clone. Fix partial-seed restoration before sharing mutable state: restore earlier writes when a later seed fails, attempt all restorations, release the lock on fatal/error/cancellation, and preserve skipped-test evidence through any child-process boundary. Retain negative recovery and contamination cases. Use one matched focused comparison followed by required gate evidence; do not repeatedly benchmark until favorable. Prefer deleting per-case setup and wrappers; quantify and justify any net harness growth.

items.title: Consolidate the highest-cost equivalent implementation paths

steps.title: Consolidate the highest-cost equivalent implementation paths
steps.rationale: Use the refreshed AST census, source history and retained execution records to select a coherent high-value group rather than another isolated fixture wrapper. Trace inputs, branches, errors, side effects, lifetime and outputs across every caller; distinguish shared construction from independent behavioral oracles. Review command setup, artifact binding and execution adapters before short host-test helpers. Record equivalence and counterexamples, migrate all affected callers, remove obsolete paths, and bind owning-package behavior plus measured reduction before closure. The census command is only a baseline, never sufficient acceptance. Split genuinely independent owners at dispatch; batch related migrations within one acceptance boundary.

items.title: Reduce duplicated command and API ownership

steps.title: Reduce duplicated command and API ownership
steps.rationale: Use AST call graphs and the generated manifest to identify commands or wrappers with identical execution owners and distinguish operator from internal consumers. Preserve documented flags, exit behavior, protocols and supported compatibility consumers. Prefer existing command owners and shared typed inputs; remove obsolete duplicate dispatchers and link targets with complete caller migration. Bind exact before/after executable/export counts and owner tests before closure; manifest freshness alone cannot accept removal. Avoid introducing a new command framework or changing HTTP/audio feature scope.

items.title: Prove reduced surface and repeated verification cost

steps.title: Prove reduced surface and repeated verification cost
steps.rationale: Compare source-bound package selection and actual executed/reused/failed/unstarted work against9565ed5c using retained results. Explain each exclusion and remaining invalidator; do not sum overlapping phase times or attribute unrelated host contention to this code. Publish net SLOC/AST, clone excess, exports, binaries and measured gate/acquisition changes through existing structured evidence owners. Bind a deterministic assertion of the chosen reduction and counterexamples before closure. Preserve unresolved process-exit finding evidence:sha256:d48c972c45ee19bd89d2f96db2437198c5688e4db2fe02759c7ede8ffe3f5da2 until explained; successful later runs do not prove it fixed. Propose the next high-value local slice from remaining measured costs; do not restore foreign rows or equate no current assignment with no useful work.
